result.reason: The revisions appropriately extend the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors and preserve successor transferability. However, Section 13.3 permits revocation or suspension of “a licence” for specified breaches, which facially conflicts with Section 13.2’s requirement that paid-up licences be irrevocable. In addition, the subscription licence is protected only against revocation or suspension; the language does not expressly restrict termination to an uncured material breach. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language gaps. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial intent, but the internal inconsistency and termination omission reduce drafting quality.
